sn35.31:1.1: sāvatthiyaṃ– sabbamaññitasamugghātasappāyaṃ vo bhikkhave, paṭipadaṃ desissāmi.
sn35.31:1.4: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu cakkhuṃ na maññati, cakkhusmiṃ na maññati, cakkhuto na maññati, cakkhuṃ meti na maññati.
sn35.31:1.6: cakkhuviññāṇaṃ na maññati …pe… cakkhusamphassaṃ na maññati …pe… yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi na maññati, tasmimpi na maññati, tatopi na maññati, tammeti na maññati.
sn35.31:1.7: yaṃ hi bhikkhave, maññati, yasmiṃ maññati, yato maññati, yammeti maññati, tato taṃ hoti aññathā.
sn35.31:1.9: jivhaṃ na maññati, jivhāya na maññati, jivhāto na maññati, jivhā meti na maññati.
sn35.31:1.12: yampidaṃ jivhāsamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi na maññati, tasmimpi na maññati, tatopi na maññati, tammeti na maññati.
sn35.31:1.13: yaṃ hi bhikkhave maññati, yasmiṃ maññati, yato maññati, yammeti maññati, tato taṃ hoti aññathā.
sn35.31:1.15: manaṃ na maññati, manasmiṃ na maññati, manato na maññati, mano meti na maññati.
sn35.31:1.17: manoviññāṇaṃ na maññati …pe… mano samphassaṃ na maññati.
sn35.31:1.18: yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi na maññati, tasmimpi na maññati, tatopi na maññati, tammeti na maññati.
sn35.31:1.19: yaṃ hi bhikkhave maññati, yasmiṃ maññati, yato maññati, yammeti maññati, tato taṃ hoti aññathā.
sn35.31:1.21: yāvatā bhikkhave, khandhadhātuāyatanaṃ tampi na maññati, tasmimpi na maññati, tatopi na maññati, tammeti na maññati.
sn35.31:1.22: so evaṃ na maññamāno na ca kiñci loke upādiyati.
sn35.31:1.23: anupādiyaṃ na paritassati. aparitassaṃ paccattaññeva parinibbāyati.
sn35.31:1.24: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānāti.
